status: proposed - rework round 3 against the owner-approved A1 target frame; awaiting human art review

changes: palette: one combined kit palette (named ramp colours); each atlas grid uses a subset of at most 63 opaque colours (was one shared <= 64 palette)
layers: new parallax_far / parallax_mid roles (kind 'parallax', horizontally tiled strips with a parallax factor); collision now draws before structure and props; every layer names a light_group

floor: the walking line replaces the tile top as the collision surface (walk_line_y per walkable tile, collider rect per collidable tile); deck_back tiles are non-collidable visual floor in the collision layer
arch openings: backwall tiles are absent inside an arch window and the parallax gallery shows through (recess_* tiles and far_arcade_* pieces removed)
lights: emitter metadata on pieces and a layout-level lighting profile (presentation only)
migration.removed_ids: all v1 tile and piece ids (no v1 id keeps its meaning)

palette_policy.note: Grid palette entries must match a kit palette entry by name and rgba; grid keys are atlas-local.

coordinate_system.note: Layout pixel (x, y) = (col * 16, row * 16). Atlas rects are [x, y, w, h] in exported atlas pixels, top-left origin. Bevy (y-up) must flip y.

roles.parallax_far: Farthest gallery strip seen through arch windows; tiles horizontally; moves at its layer's parallax factor.
roles.parallax_mid: Nearer gallery strip (balcony, pillars, arches) with 1-bit alpha over parallax_far.
roles.collision: Collision-layer terrain. Collidable tiles are opaque and carry a collider rect; deck_back tiles are opaque but non-collidable (visual floor behind the walking line).
roles.backwall: Non-collidable wall behind actors; tiles opaque, decals 1-bit alpha; never inside an arch window.
roles.structure: Non-collidable architecture (arch rings, piers, threshold, pilaster); 1-bit alpha.
roles.prop: Non-collidable props (torches, pipes, valve, collars, door, lichen); 1-bit alpha.
roles.foreground: Restrained foreground silhouettes drawn over actors (low rubble only).

walk_line.definition: The collision surface of a floor column is its walking line, not the top of its first opaque tile. A walkable tile declares walk_line_y (0..15, tile-local); the collider top in layout pixels is row * 16 + walk_line_y. The deep floor shows a 24 px top surface: the deck_back tile (16 px, non-collidable) plus 8 px of the deck_front tile; the walking line sits 20 px behind... i.e. 4 px behind the front edge (lip) of the surface.
walk_line.collider_rule: Every collidable tile has collider [x, y, w, h] (tile-local px). Bevy: for each collidable cell, spawn (or merge per row) a static AABB at (col * 16 + x, row * 16 + y, w, h), flipping y for y-up. A deck_front tile's collider is [0, 4, 16, 12]; full tiles use [0, 0, 16, 16].
walk_line.actor_contact: Actors are drawn with their pivot row (bottom opaque row) at collider_top - 1: feet touch the walking line with 0 px sink. Spawn/exit markers use y = collider_top - 1 of their column.
walk_line.wall_columns: A column that is collidable from the top row to the bottom row is a wall (corridor end), not floor.

lighting.note: Lights never change collision, gameplay or authoritative state. Pixel art carries baked light (A1); emitters drive the screen-resolution lighting pass (cold ambient multiply per light group, warm pools, additive glow, flame bloom, per-layer haze).

emitter_schema.offset: [x, y] piece-local px of the light centre
emitter_schema.radius: falloff radius in virtual px (windowed inverse-square-like)
emitter_schema.intensity: multiplier added to the group's ambient light map
emitter_schema.flicker: optional list of intensity multipliers, one per animation frame
emitter_schema.project: optional 'walk_line': the light centre moves straight down to the column's walking line plus project_dy
emitter_schema.squash_y: optional vertical squash of the falloff (flat floor pools)
emitter_schema.group: light group the emitter lights (scene, parallax_far, parallax_mid); scene emitters also light actors at the actors group's light_scale

usage_rules.rows: Base corridor: rows 0-1 ceiling (ceiling_fill, cornice), rows 2-16 brick bands (top 2-3, upper 4-7, mid 8-12, lower 13-14, low 15-16: the lit band behind actor heads), row 17 base_course, row 18 deck_back, row 19 deck_front (walking line y = 308), row 20 face_a, row 21 face_b, rows 22+ fill. A raised platform shifts its own floor stack up by 1 or 2 rows.
usage_rules.panels: Within a row a panel cell is followed by its right neighbour; a panel's last column may be followed by column 0 of any panel of the same family (solo panels are one tile wide). Cut bricks and slabs at panel edges use a neutral tone, so panels join seamlessly.
usage_rules.edges: Floor-stack singles: *_wall_l right of a corridor end wall; *_inner_r / *_inner_l on the lower floor left / right of a platform; *_end_l / *_end_r as the first / last column of a platform. A single must touch panel edge columns (last column on its left, column 0 on its right).
usage_rules.A: Ordinary fabric: brick bands, base course, deck tones dim/mid/lit (lit under a torch, mid next to it), torch_wall + torch_pool_a/b at wall mount height, at least 240 px between pooled torches; occasional grime_*, door_timber, torch_wall_unlit or one pilaster_plain.
usage_rules.B: Arch bay, 304 px wide from a 16 px aligned bay origin (y = 32): pier_l (+0,0), arch_ring_a/b (+16,0), pier_r (+224,0), arch_threshold (+64,240), torch_wall on both piers (+24,176) and (+264,176). Backwall cells that touch the ring window stay empty; the parallax strips show through. Piers bake their own torch light; do not add pools at pier torches.
usage_rules.C: Special function, sparing: one copper run with elbows, at least one flange and bracket, a valve_wheel on a vertical drop; every end terminates in pipe_collar_ceiling / pipe_collar_floor; optional lichen_crust near a pipe joint only. Copper only in C.
usage_rules.lights: Torch pools are baked for wall torches only (torch_pool_*), centred on the flame; their decal is placed at (flame_x - 120, 48).
usage_rules.grid_snap: Piece top-left positions must be multiples of grid_snap; fixed_y pieces must use that y.
